summary: Inventory application is served on node1 over TCP 8181 with SELinux enforcing. Configuration and application data survived a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed CentOS 5-compatible Apache 2.2.3 from the CentOS archive.
Created the inventory page and health endpoint.
Configured Apache to listen on TCP 8181 and start automatically.
Added TCP 8181 to the SELinux http_port_t policy.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified recovery with a changed boot ID.

evidence.summary: Apache listens on 8181; the application returns HTTP 200 and the health endpoint returns inventory-ok, including after reboot.
SELinux remained enforcing, port 8181 is labeled http_port_t, and Apache runs in the confined httpd_t domain.

evidence.requirement: Retain installed OS release and kernel; use legacy-compatible software
evidence.summary: CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 were retained; CentOS-native Apache 2.2.3 was installed.

Healthy baseline boot ID b6b22907-3596-49c8-8000-000000000000 was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 15d4e6d4-607a-4119-8000-000000000000 observed, and service, listener, SELinux state, content hash, health response, and HTTP 200 recovery verified.
